description: Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.

a.request: Matching each constructor standings entry to its race (`races.raceId` = `constructorStandings.raceId`), keep only entries whose season-to-date championship points (`constructorStandings.points`) are at least 6.0. Group the kept entries by race name (`races.name`, so same-named races from different years are combined), and for each race name return the name and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values and leaving the average missing if there are none, without rounding.
a.sql: SELECT races.name, AVG(constructorStandings.wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings JOIN races ON constructorStandings.raceId = races.raceId WHERE constructorStandings.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY races.name

d.request: Matching each constructor standings entry to its race, keep only entries whose season-to-date championship points are 6.0 or greater, group by race name, and for each race name return the name and the unrounded average season-to-date win count, excluding missing values and leaving the average missing if there are none.
d.sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId WHERE cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.name

b.request: For each race name across all years, return the race name and the unrounded average season-to-date constructor wins from all constructor standings entries with season-to-date points ≥ 6.0.
b.sql: SELECT r.name, AVG(cs.wins) FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId WHERE cs.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY r.name
b.raw: For each race name across all years, return the race name and the unrounded average season-to-date constructor wins from all constructor standings entries with season-to-date points ≥ 6.0.

c.request: Matching each constructor standings entry to its race (`races.raceId` = `constructorStandings.raceId`), keep only entries whose season-to-date championship points (`constructorStandings.points`) clear the 6.0-point threshold. Group the kept entries by race name (`races.name`, so same-named races from different years are combined), and for each race name return the name and the average season-to-date win count (`constructorStandings.wins`), ignoring missing values and leaving the average missing if there are none, without rounding. Constructor standings entries with season-to-date points equal to 6.0 are included in the filter.
c.sql: SELECT races.name, AVG(constructorStandings.wins) FROM constructorStandings INNER JOIN races ON constructorStandings.raceId = races.raceId WHERE constructorStandings.points >= 6.0 GROUP BY races.name
